question: Supreme powers of Śiva, declared by knowers of that as Aghorā; elsewhere also power of action of Śiva operating in the bound soul?
premises: supreme powers are declared by knowers
they are Aghorā powers of Śiva
elsewhere action-power operates in the bound soul
inference: Aghorā powers of Śiva are declared, while action-power also operates in the bound soul elsewhere.
plain_english: Supreme powers of Śiva are declared by knowers of that as Aghorā; elsewhere also the power of action of Śiva operates in the bound soul.
